title: 'Odebu Akujo ni Tensei shitara, Nazeka Last Boss Oujisama ni Shuuchaku sareteimasu' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, First Promo, Winter 2027 Premiere
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kotoko and Kaname Hanamiya 's Odebu Akujo ni Tensei shitara, Nazeka Last Boss Oujisama ni Shuuchaku sareteimasu ( The Final-Boss Prince Is Somehow Obsessed with the Chubby Villainess: Reincarnated Me ) web manga revealed additional cast, staff, a first key visual (pictured), and the first promotional video on Wednesday. The anime will premiere on Tokyo MX, BS Nippon, AT-X, CBC TV, and other stations in January 2027.

Voice actors Shunichi Toki ( Kuroneko to Majo no Kyoushitsu ) and Fuuka Izumi ( Shibou Yuugi de Meshi wo Kuu. ) are joining the cast as Louis and Adele, respectively.

Staff Art Director: Yuri Takagi ( Watashi no Yuri wa Oshigoto desu! ), Keito Watanabe ( Watashi ga Koibito ni Nareru Wake Nai jan, Muri Muri! ) 3D Art Setting: Jishiro Shida Color Design: Taeko Mizuno ( Ragna Crimson ) 2D Design: Suguru Shiga Director of Photography: Kenji Takehara ( Watashi wo Tabetai, Hitodenashi ) Editing: Hitomi Sudou ( Uruwashi no Yoi no Tsuki ) Sound Director: Ryousuke Naya ( Hanaori-san wa Tensei shitemo Kenka ga Shitai ) Sound Effects: Yuka Kazama ( Haibara-kun no Tsuyokute Seishun New Game ) Music: Tsubasa Itou ( Osananajimi to wa Love Comedy ni Naranai )

Naoyuki Kuzuya ( Eiyuuou, Bu wo Kiwameru Tame Tenseisu ) is directing the anime at Studio Lings , with Shuusaku Katou ( Sorairo Utility (TV) episode director) serving as the assistant director. Mitsutaka Hirota ( Kanojo ga Koushaku-tei ni Itta Riyuu ) is handling the series composition and script. Fumino Kakihata ( Watashi no Yuri wa Oshigoto desu! chief animation director) and Yukiko Sekita ( Maou no Ore ga Dorei Elf wo Yome ni Shitanda ga, Dou Medereba Ii? animation director) are designing the characters.

Kotoko and Hanamiya began serializing the fantasy romance web manga on the Mecha Comic and Comico Japan in April 2023. Kadokawa Shoten released the fifth volume on February 14.

NHN comico Corp. originally licensed the manga for digital release in English through their Pocket Comics platform in September 2024. The series has been licensed by Manga Mirai since October 2025.

title: New Fairy Princess Minky Momo Original Video Anime Delayed
content:
The committee apologized to fans looking forward to the anime and all those involved in the production, and said it will announce the new opening date, as soon as it is decided, on the anime's official website and social media accounts. People who bought advance tickets for the screenings can still use them after the new opening date.

The new OVA 's story is set in Diginarsa, the land of dreams and hopes, which maintains its existence through dream energy. But the land is in danger of disappearing as humans lose their dreams and hopes, and the dream energy decreases. As a last resort, the land's king sends off his three companions Chamocha, Dettabook, and Pipirupi to Min ky Momo for help.

On her 12th birthday, a girl named Momo received a smartphone as a present, and awakens as Min ky Momo after meeting the king's companions and resolves herself to save Diginarsa. As Momo steadily collects dream energy, a mysterious app begins to become popular in the city. But the dreams that children talk about in the app are nothing but frivolous dreams only driven by the desire for recognition or boosting their viewing numbers. Momo starts to question everyone's dreams.

The OVA stars:

• Kurumi Haruki as Minky Momo

• Fukushi Ochiai as Dettabook

• Natsumi Fujiwara as Chamocha

• Rie Kugimiya as Pipirupi

• Tomohito Takatsuka as Rubato

• Yōko Hikasa as Peter

• Show Hayami as the King of Diginarsa

• Kikuko Inoue as the Queen of Diginarsa

• Kazuyuki Okitsu as Momo's kind father

• Mie Sonozaki as Momo's mother, who is a bit of a worrywart

Ayumu Watanabe ( Witch Hat Atelier , Akane-banashi , Space Brothers ) is directing the anime at Ashi Production . The original 1982-1983 anime's main animator Hiroshi Watanabe and Minky Momo in The Station of Your Memories key animator Mari Tominaga are designing the characters. Deko Akao ( Arakawa Under the Bridge two seasons, Pretty Rhythm Aurora Dream ) is writing the script, Katsunori Shimizu ( Magical Girl Ore , Citrus) is the sound director, Zack Promotion is in charge of sound production, and Tomoki Hasegawa ( Minky Momo in The Station of Your Memories , Cherry Magic! Thirty Years of Virginity Can Make You a Wizard?! ) is composing the music. Studio Live is credited for design cooperation. MOVIC and Giggly Box are distributing.

The new OVA will be the franchise 's first new one since 1994's Minky Momo in The Station of Your Memories , 32 years ago.

William Winckler Productions launched an Amazon Instant Video release of the 1982-1983 television anime as English-dubbed features in 2015, and it described the story:

In Minky Momo , a princess from a magical world is sent to Earth to help people recover their lost hopes and dreams. Using her magic, and with the aid of her magical dog, monkey and bird, Minky – known on Earth as “Gigi” – encounters amazing adventures.

The 1982-1983 series inspired a television series followup in 1991-1992 and several OVAs. Harmony Gold USA released the Fairy Princess Minky Momo: La ronde in my dream OVA in English as Gigi and the Fountain of Youth . Crunchyroll began streaming the original television anime in January 2024.

title: Voice Actor Kenjirō Tsuda's TikTok Lawsuit Dismissed After AI-Voiced Videos' Removal
content:
The Singaporean company that operates TikTok in Japan reported that the videos had been removed after the lawsuit's November 2025 filing. Thus, the company argued that Tsuda no longer has a legal interest in continuing the case.

According to the lawsuit's filing, an unidentified individual owned the TikTok account that posted at least 188 videos dealing with urban legends and conspiracy theories between July 2024 and September 2025. According to information the individual posted on another site, the revenue from the videos was estimated between 500,000 and 750,000 yen (about US$3,000 to US$4,500) per month.

Tsuda's legal team argued that the videos featured narration generated by AI to imitate Tsuda's characteristic "smooth, low-pitched" and "deep, husky" voice. They claimed that the videos were misleading viewers into believing that the narration is Tsuda's voice, thus attracting them. Tsuda's camp had sought the removal of the videos based on the Unfair Competition Prevention Act and the right of publicity, which is the right to protect the image of public figures such as celebrities and entertainers.

The defense had argued that the voice in the narration was a "universal male voice" generated by training AI on the voice of the poster's friend, as was stated on the poster's external website. The company's lawyers argued that there was no confusion and therefore no violation of the law. TikTok also denied any infringement of publicity rights, arguing that most of the comments on the videos were opinions and reactions regarding to the content, and the viewers were not drawn in by the voice of the narration.

In related news, an expert panel for the Ministry of Justice issued guidelines in August on how to interpret the existing laws to protect voices from unauthorized generative AI use. The guidelines indicated that the voices of voice actors and actors are legally protected under the right of publicity, just as their likenesses (e.g. photographs) are. The guidelines also indicated that depending on how much they infringed on that right, generative AI providers could face joint liability.

title: Phoenix Gramedia Licenses Imasara Desu ga, Osananajimi o Suki ni Natte Shimaimashita Light Novel
content:
Kadokawa and Gramedia's Phoenix Gramedia company announced on Tuesday that it has licensed Fumiaki Maruto and Yom 's Imasara Desu ga, Osananajimi o Suki ni Natte Shimaimashita light novel, and will release it "soon."

The story centers on the relationship between high school girl Hikari and her childhood friend of 10 years nicknamed Ta-kun. Now as high schoolers, their relationship becomes closer and closer, until it reaches a turning point. Though seemingly straightforward, their romance takes unexpected twists and turns later in the story.

Maruto and Yom launched the light novel and manga at the same time, and they continue to be serialized. Maruto serializes the chapters in the note website, with accompanying illustrations by Yom . Yom also draws the manga adaptation, which runs in both X/Twitter and Comic Apanta.

Kadokawa published the first novel volume and the first compiled book volume for the manga both in August 2025, and released the second novel volume and second manga volume on March 10.

Maruto is perhaps best known for penning the story to the White Album 2 romantic drama visual novel. The visual novel inspired a 2010 television anime. Maruto also wrote the Saenai Heroine no Sodate-kata ( How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend ) light novel series, which inspired a manga adaptation, two television anime seasons, and a film. Maruto is also the head writer for the Classroom Crisis , Engage Kiss , SI-VIS: The Sound of Heroes original anime.
author: ANN

title: AFA Singapore 2026 Adds 3 Liella! Members, May'n, kz to Musical Guests
content:
The AFA Singapore convention announced on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday, that it will host three members of Love Live! Superstar!! 's Liella! group, kz (livetune), and May'n as its musical guests. The three Liella! members are Liyuu (playing Keke Tang), Naomi Payton (playing Sumire Heanna), and Yuina (playing Wien Margarete).

Previously announced musical guests include composer and musician Yuki Kajiura , Kamitsubaki Studio singers KAF and Isekaijoucho , and singer CHiCO ( CHICO with Honeyworks ), along with HoneyWorks Vocal All Stars.

The convention will take place at the Suntec Singapore International Convention and Exhibition Centre in Singapore on November 27 to 29.

Last year's Singapore convention took place in November 2025.

This year's AFA Thailand took place on May 30 and 31. AFA Indonesia took place on August 15 and 16.

The convention was planned to return to Hong Kong with a new event at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Center on February 14 and 15, 2026, but Sozo postponed the convention with no new date announced.

Sozo organizes the Anime Festival Asia conventions, which take place annually in Singapore, and has also held events in Indonesia, Hong Kong, and Japan. It is one of the largest anime and Japanese pop-culture conventions outside Japan. 2024's Anime Festival Asia in Singapore drew 130,000 attendees. Aside from Anime Festival Asia and its attached I Love Anisong label, Sozo also owns JLive Asia, and organizes the Japan Music Festival brand, and also organizes concerts for individual Japanese acts. Kadokawa acquired Sozo in December 2025.

title: BanG Dream! Ave Mujica Film Opens in Taiwan on Same Day as Japan on October 16
content:
Taiwanese anime distributor Bahamut Animation Crazy announced on Monday that Muse Asia will open the BanG Dream! Ave Mujica prima aurora anime film in Taiwan on October 16, the same day it opens in Japan.

The film is a sequel to both BanG Dream! It's MyGo!!!!! and BanG Dream! Ave Mujica .

The BanG Dream! Ave Mujica television anime premiered in Japan in January 2025. Muse Asia streamed the anime as it aired in Japan.

The BanG Dream! It's MyGo!!!!! /Ave Mujica sequel television anime series will premiere in January 2027.

BanG Dream! It's MyGo!!!!! premiered in Japan on Tokyo MX and streaming service ABEMA with three episodes in June 2023. Muse Asia streamed the anime as it aired in Japan.

The anime has two compilation films . Haru no Hidamari, Mayoi Neko (A Sunny Spot in Spring, A Stray Cat), the first film, opened in September 2024. The second film, titled Utau, Bokura ni Nareru Uta (Sing, the Song That Can Define Us), opened in November 2024.

Bushiroad launched the BanG Dream! multimedia project in January 2015. The main BanG Dream! television anime's first 13-episode season premiered in January 2017. The BanG Dream! 3rd Season television anime debuted in January 2020.

The franchise also includes the BanG Dream! FILM LIVE and BanG Dream! FILM LIVE 2nd Stage films, the two-part BanG Dream! Episode of Roselia films, as well as several web anime spinoff series.

title: Muse Asia Licenses Toaru Anbu no Item Anime
content:
Muse Asia announced last Friday that it has licensed the television anime of Kazuma Kamachi 's Toaru Anbu no Item (A Certain ITEM of the Dark Side) spinoff novel. The anime will begin streaming in October.

The anime will debut in Japan on October 9.

The anime is the latest series in A Certain Magical Index franchise , and the "ITEM" in the title refers to the secret organization ITEM at Academy City. The novel series' story follows the women of the "dark side" of Academy City.

The anime stars:

• Ami Koshimizu as Shizuri Mugino

• Aya Suzaki as Rikou Takitsubou

• Maaya Uchida as Frenda Seivelun

• Chinatsu Akasaki as Saiai Kinuhata

A Certain Scientific Railgun anime director Tatsuyuki Nagai is also directing the Toaru Anbu no Item anime at J.C. Staff , and A Certain Scientific Railgun , A Certain Magical Index series chief animation director Shigeki Kimoto is designing the characters. Maiko Iuchi ( A Certain Magical Index , A Certain Scientific Railgun , A Certain Scientific Accelerator , Selector Infected Wixoss ) is the anime's musical composer.
author: ANN

title: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU Climax! Anime Streams in India
content:
The second season of the anime began streaming on the channel on September 10. The first season began streaming on September 4.

Kei Oikawa ( Hinamatsuri , Outbreak Company ) returned from the second season to direct the third season at studio feel. ( Brains Base animated the first season.) Keiichirō Ōchi ( Hinamatsuri , The Quintessential Quintuplets ), a scriptwriter on the second season, supervised the series scripts. Yūichi Tanaka ( A Certain Magical Index , A Certain Scientific Railgun ) also returned from the second season as character designer. Nagi Yanagi returned to perform the opening theme song "Megumi no Ame" (Budding Rain), and Saori Hayami and Nao Tōyama perform the ending song "Diamond no Jundo" (Purity of a Diamond) as their respective characters.

Watari began the original light novels with illustrations by Ponkan8 in Japan in 2011. The series' final arc began with the 12th volume, which shipped in September 2017. The 14th volume ended the novel series' main story, and shipped in Japan in November 2019. The novels also received a series of short story collections titled Yahari Ore no Seishun Love Come wa Machigatteiru. Shin , a new volume of which shipped with each of the six Blu-ray Disc volumes of the anime's third season. The short stories are set on the day immediately after the ending in the 14th volume. Watari also wrote a more recent "volume 14.5" for the series, which shipped in April 2021, and tells the story of Komachi and Iroha, the new generation of the Service Club. A new novel volume titled Yahari Ore no Seishun Love Come wa Machigatteiru. Yui (My Youth Romantic Comedy Is Wrong, As I Expected. Connection) shipped in September 2021, and was initially announced as the first volume of a new series.

Kazuki launched the Yahari Ore no Seishun Love Come wa Machigatteiru. -Monologue- manga in Monthly Big Gangan in September 2012. The manga ended in April 2023. The manga is a separate manga based on Wataru Watari 's My Youth Romantic Comedy Is Wrong, As I Expected franchise . Kazuki's Yahari Ore no Seishun Love Come wa Machigatteiru. -Monologue- manga is based more on the story as told in the novels' anime adaptation, which omits some stories, and adds or changes the context of some scenes. Naomichi Io 's My Youth Romantic Comedy Is Wrong, As I Expected @ comic is based directly on Watari's original light novels. The My Youth Romantic Comedy Is Wrong, As I Expected @ comic manga launched in Shogakukan 's Sunday GX magazine in 2012, and ended in February 2023.

Kazuki launched the Yahari Ore no Seishun Love Come wa Machigatteiru. -Monologue- manga in Monthly Big Gangan in September 2012. The manga ended in April 2023. The manga is a separate manga based on Wataru Watari 's My Youth Romantic Comedy Is Wrong, As I Expected franchise . Kazuki's Yahari Ore no Seishun Love Come wa Machigatteiru. -Monologue- manga is based more on the story as told in the novels' anime adaptation, which omits some stories, and adds or changes the context of some scenes. Naomichi Io 's My Youth Romantic Comedy Is Wrong, As I Expected @ comic is based directly on Watari's original light novels. The My Youth Romantic Comedy Is Wrong, As I Expected @ comic manga launched in Shogakukan 's Sunday GX magazine in 2012, and ended in February 2023.

title: Ani-One Asia Licenses 'As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World' Season 3, Suikoden: The Anime,
content:
Ani-One Asia announced on Sunday that it has licensed the third season of the As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World television anime , with the first episode already available. Ani-One Asia also announced on Tuesday that it has licensed Suikoden: The Anime and the second season of With Vengeance, Sincerely, Your Broken Saintess .

Muse Asia is streaming the third season of the television anime of Miraijin A 's (also known as Jinei Mirai's) As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World ( Tensei Kizoku Kantei Sukiru de Nariagaru - Jakushō Ryōchi o Uketsuidanode, Yūshūna Jinzai o Fuyashite Itara, Saikyō Ryōchi ni Natteta ) light novel series in Brunei, Cambodia, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Laos, Macau, Malaysia, Mongolia, Myanmar, South Korea, the Philippines, Singapore, Taiwan, Thailand, Timor-Leste, and Vietnam. The anime debuted in Japan on September 27. Ani-One Asia describes the anime:

In recognition of his achievements in the Missian War of Succession, Ars becomes the Governor of Canarre. As he establishes a new leadership system, the next enemy approaches; a turbulent new chapter begins alongside new allies!

Takao Kato ( To Love-Ru , Zoids ) returns to direct the third season at new studio GeyeG Pictures . Daisuke Ōhigashi , who wrote episode scripts for the previous seasons, is now overseeing the series scripts, replacing Yasuhiro Nakanishi . Yūko Yahiro ( Kaguya-sama: Love is War ) is also back to design the characters, and Kujira Yumemi ( In the Land of Leadale ) returns to compose the music.

Returning cast members include:

• Natsumi Fujiwara as Ars Louvent

• Taito Ban as Ritsu Muses

• Narumi Kaho as Charlotte Wraith

• Miho Okasaki as Rosell Kischa

• Kana Hanazawa as Lycia Plaid

• Hitomi Nabatame as Mireille Grandion

• Haruka Tomatsu as Fahm

New cast members include Sumire Morohoshi as Musia Trick and Hinata Tadokoro as Zaht Brouzdo.

The first anime season premiered in April 2024. Ani-One Asia streamed the anime in Southeast Asia as it aired in Japan.

The second season premiered in Japan in September 2024. Ani-One Asia streamed the anime as it aired in Japan.

Ani-One Asia did not reveal regional streaming details for Suikoden: The Anime , the adaptation of Konami 's Suikoden II game's story. The anime will debut in Japan on October 3.

Ani-One Asia describes the anime:

"I though if I was that strong, I could protect everyone." Two young boys, Riliu and his best friend Jowy, belonged to a youth brigade in the Highland Kingdom. They shared the same starry skies and believed in a peaceful future once the fighting ended. Contrary to their hopes, the flames of war swept them into a whirlpool of fate. Reaching for immense power, the powerless boys step forward under 108 brightly shining stars, driven by their own beliefs to seek an answerless question.

Yūzō Satō (credited as just YUZO on the anime's English website) is directing the anime at KONAMI animation , the game studio's anime studio. NBCUniversal Entertainment Japan anime and music production department member Ryō Hino serves as the producer and production manager.

Michihiro Tsuchiya ( PriPara , ClassicaLoid ) is overseeing the series scripts. Fumi Ishikawa from Konami Digital Entertainment is credited as the game character designer, Arata Suzuki from Konami Digital Entertainment is credited for the original drafts of the anime character designs, and Ryō Yamauchi ( My Master Has No Tail ; Please Put Them On, Takamine-san! ) is the anime character designer. Yoshikazu Iwanami ( Psycho-Pass , Ghost in the Shell Arise ) is the sound director, and Kōji Nakamura ( EUREKA SEVEN AO , Ping Pong live-action film) is composing the music.

Ani-One Asia did not reveal regional streaming details for the second light anime season based on SORAJIMA and Aminohada 's With Vengeance, Sincerely, Your Broken Saintess ( Kizu Darake Seijo Yori Hōfuku wo Komete ) vertical-scrolling webtoon. The anime will debut in Japan on October 1.

Ani-One Asia describes the anime:

Keio Year 3, Hinomoto Edo, a stormy era later known as the Bakumatsu. A life-risking duel known as "Eternal", a battle permitted only to samurai. And among the common people, a "Standard Battle" without the stakes of life and death was beginning to spread. When two souls cross, history begins to move...

Returning cast members from the first season include:

• Asami Seto as Rua

• Sōma Saitō as Sven

• Momo Asakura as Arianne

• Kazuki Ura as Garrett

• Kazuyuki Okitsu as Cezee

• Tomoaki Maeno as Prince Sarid

• Minami Tsuda as Diana Peridot

• Reiō Tsuchida as Luis Riston

Saya Fukase ( Hyakki Yakou Shou , I Want You To Show Me Your Panties With a Disgusted Face Returns ) is directing the anime at IMAGICA Infos / Imageworks Studio , replacing first season's director Chisaki . Returning staff members include sound director Yūichi Imaizumi , Hiroki Nozaki and Airi Kobayashi for sound effects, music composer onoken , and Kazuya Takahashi overseeing the production.

The anime's first season debuted in July 2025 on tvk and CBC TV , and also streamed on various streaming services in Japan. Ani-One Asia streamed the anime as it aired in Japan.

title: Aniplus Asia Airs Simulcast of Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers, The Salty Koharu Has a Soft Spot for Me
content:
Aniplus Asia announced on Friday and Monday that it will air simulcasts for the Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers anime and The Salty Koharu Has a Soft Spot for Me anime for the fall 2026 anime season.

The television anime of Isle Osaki 's Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers ( Shinja Zero no Megami-sama to Hajimeru Isekai Kōryaku , or Clear the world like a game with the zero believers goddess ) light novel series will debut in Japan on October 11.

The anime will star Sōhei Horikane as Makoto Takatsuki and Ikumi Hasegawa as Noah Titan.

Riki Fukushima ( Tamayomi: The Baseball Girls , Skate-Leading Stars , Magilumiere Magical Girls Inc. season 2) is directing the anime at HORNETS . Tōko Machida ( Tamayomi: The Baseball Girls , My Master Has No Tail ) is writing and supervising the series' scripts. Noriko Itō ( Undead Murder Farce ) is designing the characters, while Minoru Tanaka is the sub-character designer. Itō and Tanaka are also the chief animation directors along with Yoshihiro Nagamori , who is also the monster designer. Chiharu Nishimura is the prop designer. Nobuaki Kikuchi is the CG director. Chiho Nakamura and Masao Ōba are the color designers. Yasutoshi Kawai is the art director. Ayumu Kaikiri ( Studio Twinkle ) is the compositing director of photography. Takahiro Adachi ( IMAGICA EMS ) is in charge of editing. Hiroto Morishita is the sound director, while Dax Production is credited for sound production. AstroNoteS is composing the music.

J-Novel Club licensed both the novel series and its manga adaptation, and it describes the story:

Makoto Takatsuki is a normal high school student and a hardcore RPG player. However, “normal” goes out the window when his whole class is involved in a bus crash and whisked away to another world! Powerful gods rule this strange new land of magic and monsters, and every newcomer is blessed with strong stats and unique skills. Well, not quite. Makoto's stats turn out to be pathetic, and his skills are super weak compared to his classmates'...he's even stuck as an apprentice mage. Worse still, he's given only ten years to live! Luckily, Makoto soon meets a minor goddess named Noah, who appears in Makoto's dreams and asks him to become her first believer. With the help of Noah's blessings and a divine weapon, Makoto seeks to become strong enough to rescue his goddess from the dungeon where she's been trapped. By training hard and using his weak skills in unorthodox ways, Makoto proves that, even when playing on hardcore difficulty, an RPG player always makes it to the end!

The television anime adaptation of Kazami Sawatari and illustrator Achiki 's The Salty Koharu Has a Soft Spot for Me ( Shiotaiō no Satō-san ga Ore ni Dake Amai ) light novel series will debut in Japan on October 6.

The coming-of-age romantic comedy depicts the first love between two people — except each one has unrequited love for the other. Sōta Oshio works at a café. He learns one day that Koharu Satō, a classmate known as "cold Satō-san," is actually just shy and awkward. From that day forward, the distance between the two quickly narrows …

The anime stars:

• Hiiro Ishibashi as Sōta Oshio

• Miku Itō as Koharu Satō

• Miyu Tomita as Rinka Sudō

• Chiaki Kobayashi as Ren Misono

• Yoshino Aoyama as Shizuku Misono

• Hisako Kanemoto as Mayo Nezu

• Yasunori Matsumoto as Seizaemon Oshio

• Yūki Wakai as Madoka Murasaki

Fumihiro Yoshimura ( My Wife Has No Emotion , Jungle Emperor Leo / Hon-o-ji ) is directing the anime at Tezuka Productions , and Takashi Aoshima ( The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You ; Himouto! Umaruchan ; Uzaki-chan Wants to Hang Out! ) is in charge of the series scripts. Daisuke Okushima is designing the characters, and Shun Narita ( 365 Days to the Wedding , The Girl in Twilight , Harmony of Mille-Feuille ) is composing the music.
